title: Frosted Privacy Window Film | VAM Deco
description: Frosted privacy film for windows, offices and bathrooms: round-the-clock privacy without losing natural light. Free consultation in Ticino.
h1: Frosted privacy film: privacy without losing light
estratto: Privacy all day long without giving up daylight: frosted window film for offices, bathrooms and storefronts.

paragrafi: Frosted privacy film screens the view while letting natural light through. It's the ideal solution for offices, bathrooms, storefronts and homes when you need privacy without closing off the space with curtains or blinds.

sezioni.heading: What it is and how it works
paragrafi: These are adhesive films applied directly to the glass, turning it into a sandblasted-effect surface. Unlike mirrored film, frosted film delivers privacy 24 hours a day: from the outside you only see blurred silhouettes, both during the day and in the evening with the lights on.
The impact on brightness is minimal. The film blocks only 20-30% of the light, so the room stays bright with soft, diffused illumination.

sezioni.heading: The main benefits
lista: Privacy without darkness: it screens the view while letting light in, perfect for bathrooms, meeting rooms and entrances.
Clean, modern look: an elegant frosted effect that suits any decor.
Added safety: if the glass breaks, the film holds the fragments together.
Removable: it can be taken off at any time without damaging the glass or frames and without leaving residue.

sezioni.heading: Where it's used
lista: Offices and meeting rooms: they divide spaces while keeping them bright.
Bathrooms and glass showers: privacy in the most private rooms of the home.
Storefronts and shops: they protect interiors with a tidy, elegant effect.
Practices and clinics: they ensure the privacy of patients and clients.

sezioni.heading: Professional installation in Ticino
paragrafi: A careful application makes the difference between an even result and one full of bubbles or hazing. A professional frosted film, applied correctly, typically lasts 8 to 15 years. In humid rooms such as bathrooms and showers, professional installation ensures a more stable hold over time.
VAM Deco applies custom frosted privacy film throughout Ticino, from choosing the film to the final application. Get in touch for a free consultation and a quote for your space.

faq.domanda: Can you see inside at night with frosted film?
faq.risposta: No. Frosted film delivers privacy 24 hours a day, even in the evening with the lights on: from the outside you can only make out blurred silhouettes. Mirrored film, on the other hand, reveals the interior at night.

faq.domanda: How much light does frosted film block?
faq.risposta: Very little. It blocks only 20-30% of the light, so the room stays bright with soft, diffused illumination, without the darkening effect of blackout films.

faq.domanda: How long does frosted film last?
faq.risposta: A professional film typically lasts 8 to 15 years. Its lifespan depends on humidity, temperature swings and how exposed the room is.

faq.domanda: Can it be removed without ruining the glass?
faq.risposta: Yes. The film can be removed at any time without damaging the glass or frames and without leaving residue, so the choice is always reversible.

faq.domanda: Is it suitable for bathrooms and glass showers?
faq.risposta: Yes, it's one of the most requested applications. In humid environments professional installation is worthwhile, as it ensures an even and longer-lasting result.
